summary: Vermilion Energy Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the voting results of its annual general meeting held on May 6, 2026. Shareholders voted on routine matters: fixing the number of directors at eight, electing eight nominees, appointing Deloitte LLP as auditors, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. All resolutions passed with strong support. Two directors retired as previously announced. This is a routine meeting results filing with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign.
